def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=g[0][0]]
    i0=min(c[0] for c in cells); i1=max(c[0] for c in cells)
    j0=min(c[1] for c in cells); j1=max(c[1] for c in cells)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==g[0][0]:
                per = i in (i0,i1) and j0<=j<=j1 or j in (j0,j1) and i0<=i<=i1
                vflank = i>0 and i<h-1 and g[i-1][j]!=g[0][0] and g[i+1][j]!=g[0][0]
                if per or vflank: out[i][j]=2
    return out
